# What this document is for

Two markers are written and both name the second index; no marker names the
first. A back-end that keeps one index builds the first index only, and with
no marker naming it the first marker of any name is where it goes — so the
first marker here places it and says so. The second is a second marker for the
index it names, which used to be dropped with nothing said at all.

One term files in each: [Alpha]{.index} and
[Babbage]{.index index="authors"}.
